title: Robert Half honored by Fortune as one of the Best Workplaces for Women 2026

body_markdown:
MENLO PARK, Calif.


, Oct. 29, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Global talent solutions and business consulting firm[Robert Half](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810018-1&h=3178161730&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4790833-1%26h%3D3950247480%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.roberthalf.com%252Fus%252Fen%26a%3DRobert%2BHalf&a=Robert+Half) (NYSE: RHI) has been selected by Fortune as one of the[Best Workplaces for Women 2026](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810018-1&h=34092166&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatplacetowork.com%2Fbest-workplaces%2Fwomen%2F2026%3Fcategory%3Dlarge&a=Best+Workplaces+for+Women+2026) , reinforcing the company's reputation as a workplace where women can build fulfilling careers.


The Best Workplaces for Women list is based on an extensive survey of approximately 640,000 women employed by Great Place To Work Certified™ companies. The evaluation considers workplace culture, benefits, advancement opportunities, programs supporting women's professional development and organizational demographics.


Women comprise 53% of Robert Half's global workforce and serve as Directors, company officers and in leadership roles across the organization.


"This recognition affirms our commitment to creating a workplace where women can advance, lead and build lasting careers," said M. Keith Waddell, President and Chief Executive Officer of Robert Half. "Investing in their professional development strengthens our organization, and we are committed to providing the opportunities and resources they need to reach their full potential."


Robert Half's commitment comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, career development opportunities and employee networks. The company offers programs, resources and benefits designed to support employees throughout their careers and across different stages of life, including paid parental leave, infertility treatment, adoption and surrogacy assistance, and child and elder care support. Its Global Women's Employee Network (GWEN) helps women and allies across the organization connect, learn and grow.


"When employees have the support they need in both their personal and professional lives, they are empowered to thrive," said JoLynn Conway-James, Senior Executive Director and Chief Administrative Officer at Robert Half. "Our professional development programs, employee networks and family-focused resources help women broaden their opportunities and build rewarding careers."


Robert Half has also been recognized by Forbes as one of The World's Top Companies for Women, further reflecting its commitment to creating an inclusive workplace where employees can grow and succeed.


**FAQs**
**What is Fortune's Best Workplaces for Women list?**
The award recognizes Great Place To Work Certified™ companies based on feedback from approximately 640,000 women about workplace culture, benefits and advancement opportunities.


**Why was Robert Half recognized?**
The recognition reflects Robert Half's commitment to women's career advancement, leadership opportunities and workplace support.


**How does Robert Half support women?**
Robert Half provides career development, workplace flexibility, family-focused benefits and its Global Women's Employee Network (GWEN).


**About Robert Half**
Robert Half (NYSE: RHI) is the world's first and largest specialized talent solutions and business consulting firm, connecting highly skilled job seekers with rewarding opportunities at great companies. We offer contract talent and full-time placement solutions in the fields of finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative and customer support, and we also provide executive search services.


Robert Half is the parent company of Protiviti®, a global consulting firm that delivers internal audit, risk, business and technology consulting solutions. In the last 12 months, Robert Half has been recognized as one of America's Most Innovative Companies by Fortune and, with Protiviti, has been named a Fortune® Most Admired Company™ and one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For.
